title: Operating Partner
description:
Overview

An operating partner is a business leader who works with a company's leadership team to improve the business and create value for shareholders. They are often a key part of a firm's investment strategy and act as a liaison between the firm and its portfolio company. Their responsibilities can include:

  • Advising and coaching — Working with the CEO and management team to provide perspectives and recommendations.
  • Analyzing challenges — Identifying areas for improvement and developing plans to increase efficiency and growth.
  • Creating strategies — Developing plans to increase profits and cash flow, and implement operational best practices.
  • Monitoring performance — Tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) and financial performance.
  • Facilitating value creation — Ensuring the portfolio company has the resources to meet the firm's investment goals.
  • Supporting growth — Assisting with planning, forecasting, and due diligence to support company growth and expansion.
  • Building reporting — Creating simple, consistent reporting that makes it easy to identify when the company is off-track.
  • Leadership — To run a company you must be a leader. Full stop - no excuses. We are looking for Operating Partners who are natural born leaders.

What is the Cache Operating Partner Program?

The Cache Operating Partner Program is your opportunity to partner with Cache as the incoming CEO/COO/VP/GM/President of a newly acquired portfolio company.

Our Operating Partners are experienced leaders and operators currently working within a Software as a Service or Service-Based businesses in a sales, marketing, operations, or key management role. If you have a demonstrable track record of success and are looking to run an internet-based business as its operating CEO/COO/VP/GM/President we’d love to hear from you.

Applying as an Operating Partner puts you in our network for consideration when we acquire new businesses generating $500K-$5M in revenue. Operating Partners should expect excellent and unique compensation packages including equity and/or profit share participation.

Our Strategy

  • Plug & Play Systems — We use our proven playbooks to create and curate a database full of potential customers and invest in bringing value to them on an ongoing basis.
  • Remote Workforce — With a global footprint, we operate with a distributed team covering multiple time zones capable of serving our multinational customer base.
  • Winning Spirit — We bring a creative solutions mindset to problem-solving. No defeat, be optimistic. Pretty much everything is fixable, and most decisions are reversible.
  • Bunts & Singles — Narrow down the market to a specific customer that we can be the best at serving, and grow from there.

Our Thesis

There are intelligent entrepreneurs globally that are adept at identifying and building great software. Once these companies reach product-market-fit, it’s not uncommon for the company to grow beyond the founders’ core competencies.

By infusing capital and adding infrastructure, we can enable businesses to realize their full potential while continuing to scale the revenue profitably.

Our Focus

We seek to minimize risk and maximize returns, meaning we only invest in companies with a clear predictable path to success.

We will consider all types of business software and service companies, and specifically focus on the following:

  • Enterprise Software
  • SMB Software
  • Vertical Market Software
  • Tech Enabled Managed Services
  • IT Consulting
  • Ecommerce Software

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational leadership experience.
  • 5+ years of experience managing direct and/or indirect reports.
  • Extensive knowledge in operations, including resource planning, demand planning, business planning, corporate strategy, communications, leadership, benchmarking, and forecasting.
  • Required skills in market research, analytics, financial modeling, metrics analysis, and presentations.
  • Strong proficiency in Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize workloads and meet time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Must be results-oriented and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, capable of interacting with all levels of associates with tact and diplomacy.
  • Proven ability to protect confidential information.
  • Ability to travel by automobile and aircraft, with the flexibility to be away from home for extended periods.
  • Experience in managing external relations, including identifying, diversifying, building, and maintaining relationships with community organizations and leaders to secure various forms of support and partnerships.
  • Ability to manage solicitations with board members and sponsors, provide outcome reports, and lead cultivation and stewardship activities for charitable endeavors.
  • Unique compensation packages including equity and/or profit share participation.
  • Competitive Health, Dental, and Vision benefits.
  • Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Loose vacation policy.
  • Flexible work hours.

This is a great opportunity for talented people who can develop as a Accounting Lead for our office in Campinas, Brazil.

YOUR MISSION

Oversee and coordinate the company's administrative and financial activities, ensuring the efficient use of resources, compliance with accounting, tax, and legal obligations, and the generation of reliable information for decision-making. The objective is to guarantee financial stability, operational efficiency, and adequate support for other areas of the organization.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Bank Management

Third-Party Management

  • Keep customer and supplier master data up to date.

  • Control and monitor customer credit lines.

Inventory Management

  • Perform the monthly closing of the inventory module.

Fixed Assets and Leases (IFRS 16)

  • Control recorded fixed assets.
  • Manage and monitor lease agreements in accordance with IFRS 16.
  • Review monthly depreciation of fixed assets and leases.

Payroll Management

  • Calculate sales commissions payable to the sales department.
  • Review payroll processed by the accounting outsourcing company.
  • Review monthly balances to be accounted for related to health, parafiscal contributions, and social benefits.

General Accounting

  • Provide support for the proper recording of accounting transactions.
  • Validate exchange rate controls on a quarterly basis.
  • Coordinate the closing and opening of accounting periods.
  • Manage accounting structures and taxes.
  • Send the monthly closing schedule to the relevant areas.

Other Routine Activities

  • Respond to and follow up on requests from the Statutory Auditor and external advisors.
  • Respond to requests from Corporate Audit.
  • Monitor and follow up on internal control.
  • Provide administrative support in response to requests from other areas, the Finance Manager, or other corporate management.
  • Analyze and communicate transfer pricing adjustments, when applicable.
  • Request supplier approvals in accordance with compliance criteria.
  • Manage expense reports on the Rydoo platform.
  • Prepare employment certificates.
  • Fill out forms for supplier registration.
  • Follow up on requirements from control entities.
  • Attend to legal procedures that apply to the company.

THE SKILLS YOU’LL NEED

  • Desirable Postgraduate degree in Finance, Taxation, or International Standards (IFRS)
  • Minimum 5 years in accounting roles (general accounting, taxes, financial reporting), preferably in medium or large companies.
  • Languages: Portuguese, English and Spanish.
  • Brazilian accounting (local standards), taxes (ICMS, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ/CSLL), accounting reconciliations, tax compliance, reporting to the Federal Revenue Service.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel
  • Desirable use of Odoo
  • Solid knowledge of Brazilian tax and accounting legislation: IRPJ, CSLL, ICMS, ISS, PIS/COFINS
  • Brazilian accounting standards (CPCs), IFRS, internal accounting closing and reconciliation procedures
  • Active registration with the CRC (Regional Accounting Council); IFRS course or tax MBA desirable.

WE OFFER

  • Working day: Monday to Friday
  • Place of work: Initially, it will be remote work, followed by office work in Campinas, Brazil

title: Placement Matching Specialist (Fully Remote)
description:
About Virtual Internships

We’re on a mission to create a world where internships are guaranteed for all. We ensure learners have access to remote internship opportunities at innovative companies worldwide, regardless of their background, major, location, or career field choice. Our clients include universities, governments, foundations, and online education institutions.

  • $14.3million Series A fundraise announced in September 2022, with investors including Hambro Perks, Sequoia India & Surge, Arsenal Growth, Kaplan, and Ascend Vietnam Ventures
  • Ranked 20th out of 13,000 organizations to “Escape To in 2023”Featured as a Top 100 EdTech Startup by HolonIQ in 2021, 2022, and 2023
  • Rated as a Top 50 Rising Startup by Tech in Asia in 2022
  • Remote-first with 100+ employees across 20+ countries globally
  • B2B EdTech product, trusted by 100+ universities, 10,000+ interns, and 14,000+ companies

One of the core values at VI is transparency. Therefore feel free to “try before you apply” by visiting our VI-P Guide , which includes our values, how we operate, how we build our packages, and a few other snippets of who we are!

Your Role

Join the fast-paced, rapidly expanding Placements Team at Virtual Internships, where we’re guaranteeing remote internships for students worldwide. As a Placement Matching Specialist, your mission is to match interns with global companies by using creativity, persuasion, and relentless drive.

Whether you’re already in an SDR, BDR, Sales Rep or recruitment role, or even looking for a career switch from another field, this is your chance to make a real impact in a rapidly growing team.

The role will start as a 3-month full-time contract role , with potential to become permanent dependent on performance.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Securing global opportunities by placing interns with innovative companies across industries and time zones.
  • Leading the conversation in virtual meetings to present our interns and highlight the value of our internship programs.
  • Building lasting partnerships by advising companies on intern selection and supporting them throughout the process.
  • Sourcing smart through LinkedIn, cold outreach, creative networking, and any method that gets results.
  • Keeping placements on track by managing key administrative steps to ensure a smooth and efficient process.
  • (P.S. The secret password is “moo ”—you’ll need it later!)

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Global Impact: You’ll work with interns from 100+ countries and companies from 75+ countries, expanding your cultural awareness and adaptability.
  • Endless Opportunities: Every day is different—you could be speaking with CEOs from France, syncing with colleagues in South Africa, and sourcing companies in India, all in one day.
  • Networking: Build your global network by working with founders, C-level decision-makers, and inspiring leaders across various industries.
  • Rapid Growth: Be part of a fast-growing team that’s scaling rapidly to meet the demand for remote internships worldwide.

Who We're Looking For

Your Attributes

We’re looking for a powerful mix of The Self-Starter , The Persuader , and The Global Citizen — rolled into one Placement Matching Specialist. Here’s how you’ll know you’re the right fit:

  • You own the outcome: You don’t wait to be told what to do — you take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and find a way to get results. You’re outcome-obsessed and don’t shift blame. (The Driver )
  • You level up fast: You seek feedback, ask smart questions, and are eager to improve. You don’t need to have all the answers on Day 1 — but you make sure you’re sharper by Day 10. (The Learner )
  • You close the loop: You follow through with precision, push through setbacks, and go beyond the ask. You don’t just complete tasks — you finish strong and make an impact. (The Finisher )
  • You stay cool under pressure: Deadlines, shifting priorities, and high volumes don’t rattle you. You prioritize, adapt, and get it done without dropping the ball.
  • You thrive in a global, remote team: You’re comfortable with tech, culturally aware, and communicative — even across time zones. You know how to stay productive and connected without being micromanaged.

Your Experience

We know that great talent comes from all backgrounds. Ideally, you have:

  • Fluency in English (you don’t need to have an IELTS, but if you did, it would be 7.0+).
  • 1-3 years of experience in recruitment, sales, or similar roles where persuasion is key.
  • Experience working remotely or with global teams.
  • A passion for technology and the ability to quickly learn and navigate new systems.
  • A history of working in fast-paced environments with ambitious goals.
  • Cultural awareness and adaptability, especially if you’ve studied, lived, or worked abroad.
  • Proven ability to hustle, meet targets, and deliver results under pressure.

We’re also keen to hear from career switchers with strong written persuasion skills . Whether you’ve honed these in teaching , customer service , or another fast-paced role, if you:

  • Have a knack for crafting compelling messages
  • Can influence others through your writing
  • Are ready to bring your drive and adaptability into a new challenge

Virtual Internships Perks and Benefits

  • Remote-First: All roles at VI are currently and will remain remote - flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Flexible Working Hours: Start earlier, leave earlier, take a shorter lunch, or leave later, it's totally up to you.
  • Annual Leave : Wherever you are in the world, you’ll get 25 days of paid annual leave per year, plus bank holidays and 5 sick days.
  • Life Event Leave: There are moments in life where your life responsibility is a higher priority than work (e.g. moving house, your best friend getting married, your sister having a baby) therefore, you’ll get 5 days of paid life-event leave to support these occasions. You also get a day off on your birthday. This is in addition to your Annual Leave.
  • Flexible VIer Budget: You’ll receive a flexible budget of $1,000 per year that you can use on but not limited to your work setup, personal wellness, or professional development.
  • Tech: New joiners receive a budget for your company laptop depending on the role and location.

Equality & Diversity

Virtual Internships is an equal opportunity employer, committed to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants. We ensure all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.

description:
Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company.

With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location

Remote

Employment Type

Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).

As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology.

Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.

  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

description:
Como é ser uma pessoa Product Designer:

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Nossa missão é servir Canais Digitais, Marketing e Growth com tecnologia para alavancar o crescimento e a eficiência do funil de vendas. Somos um time de tecnologia responsável pelos sites das marcas do grupo (Stone, Ton e Pagar.me) — cuidando de CMS, infraestrutura e evolução contínua — e pelas ferramentas que suportam marketing e vendas, como Salesforce e Marketcloud. Trabalhamos para criar experiências digitais escaláveis, integradas e alinhadas à estratégia do negócio.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Product Designer, com foco em criação de interfaces e experiências digitais para plataformas web.
  • Capacidade de conduzir todo o processo de design, desde a pesquisa com usuários até a entrega de wireframes, protótipos e especificações.
  • Conhecimento em design systems e ferramentas como Figma, FigJam, entre outras.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa, comunicando-se com as equipes de desenvolvimento, produto e marketing para garantir que as soluções propostas atendam às necessidades do usuário e aos objetivos do negócio.
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e entrega interativa.
  • Habilidade para conduzir testes de usabilidade e análises de comportamento de usuários, garantindo que os designs sejam orientados por dados e feedback real.
  • Foco constante na experiência do usuário, sempre buscando simplificar e otimizar o design.

O que aumenta as suas chances:

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs ou no mercado financeiro.
  • Habilidade em design de interfaces para sistemas complexos e de grande escala.
  • Experiência com metodologias como Design Thinking e Lean UX.
  • Habilidade de comunicação para apresentar e defender as escolhas de design de forma clara e impactante.
  • Desejo de se atualizar constantemente sobre novas tendências e práticas no design de produtos.

Sobre a Área

A área de High Ticket está em um momento de reestruturação e crescimento. O projeto foi dividido em duas frentes: uma focada em demand conversion (atendimento ao comprador) e outra em supply (oferta). A vaga de especialista de negócios é para atuar na frente de supply, que até o momento não tinha uma pessoa dedicada para olhar para as oportunidades de forma abrangente.

Requisitos

  • Habilidades Técnicas:
    • SQL : É uma habilidade obrigatória para extração e análise de dados. Não é necessário ser um expert, mas é preciso ter um conhecimento mínimo e capacidade de se desenvolver na área.
    • Análise de dados : A habilidade mais importante, com foco em performance e diagnóstico de gargalos.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Gestão de projetos : Capacidade de organizar e gerenciar projetos, garantindo que as entregas sejam feitas.
    • Gestão de stakeholders : Habilidade de se comunicar e gerenciar expectativas com diferentes pessoas e áreas.
    • Comunicação : Fundamental para apresentar análises e resultados, e para alinhar o trabalho com os outros times.
    • Perfil executivo : Vontade e disposição para entrar na execução, não apenas na análise.

Responsabilidades

O dia a dia do especialista será bastante focado em análise de dados (aproximadamente 70%) e gestão de projetos (30%):

  • Diagnosticar problemas : Usar dados para entender os gargalos e as oportunidades no funil de supply.
  • Desenhar projetos : Estruturar e organizar planos de ação para resolver os problemas identificados.
  • Executar iniciativas : Colocar os projetos em prática, acompanhando a execução e os resultados.

title: Analyst, Business Operations
description:
Overview

Here at Shippo, we are the shipping layer of the internet and we consider ourselves to be one of the core building blocks of e-commerce. Our mission is to make merchants successful through world class shipping. With our products and solutions, we level the playing field by providing our customers with best-in-class solutions that otherwise wouldn’t be available to them. Through Shippo, e-commerce businesses, marketplaces, platforms and a variety of logistics infrastructure providers are able to connect to shipping carriers around the world from one API and dashboard. We provide our customers with the most competitive shipping rates, print labels, automated international documents, shipment tracking, facilitate the returns process and more.

We’re hiring an Analyst, Business Operations (L3) to be a high-energy generalist who thrives in spreadsheets, turns messy data into clear insights, and helps operationalize projects that move revenue and customer outcomes. You’ll start by supporting high-priority carrier operations work (e.g., data pulls, analyses to reduce billing variances), then expand into strategic analyses and GTM process improvements, especially within our platform partner ecosystem. This is an excellent role for an early-career analyst who loves data, is curious, communicates clearly, and wants broad cross-functional exposure.

Shipping & handling responsibilities

  • First 90 days: get in, get oriented, ship value
  • Own fast, accurate Google Sheets analyses and reports for carrier ops asks (think: data pulls, pivots, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, basic modeling).
  • Partner with Carrier Ops, Partnerships, Finance, and Data to triage and quantify billing variances; share your findings
  • Document your work (inputs, queries/logic, outputs) and keep stakeholders updated with crisp async comms.
  • Start learning to read SQL queries/Databricks notebooks (no pressure to write complex SQL yet).
  • Months 3–12: broaden scope, own problems
  • Drive structured analyses to support our XMS strategy (e.g., partner pipeline sizing, revenue/label volume opportunity, cohort and conversion, playbook experiments).
  • Build lightweight dashboards/trackers (Sheets/Looker) that the team can trust and reuse.
  • Help operationalize GTM projects: draft SOPs/playbooks/templates, coordinate cross-functional tasks, and close the loop with clear follow-ups.
  • Propose small process improvements that remove toil, tighten data hygiene, or improve reporting quality.

Do you tick the boxes?

  • Must haves:
  • 1 - 3 years in an analytical role (consulting, biz ops, finance/FP&A, rev ops, product analytics, or similar).
  • Google Sheets power user: pivots, lookups, array formulas, SUMIFS/COUNTIFS, filters, cleaning/joining, fast navigation.
  • Evidence of basic financial/analytical modeling and business case writing.
  • Strong written and verbal communication: you ask clarifying questions, state assumptions, and keep partners in the loop. You’re not afraid to ask the ‘dumb questions’
  • Comfortable context switching and working cross-functionally in a remote environment.
  • Nice-to-haves:
  • SQL comfort (reading/editing simple SELECT/JOIN/WHERE) and curiosity to learn more; exposure to Databricks/Looker helpful.
  • Experience building simple GTM SOPs/playbooks or standing up lightweight reporting.
  • E-commerce/logistics familiarity is optional - no prior carrier background required.

What's in the Shippo package?

  • Medical, dental, and vision healthcare coverage for you and your dependents. Pets coverage is also available!
  • Flexible policy for PTO and work arrangement
  • Two 1-week company shutdowns to rest and recharge (summer and winter)
  • 3 VTO days for ShippoCares volunteering events
  • Charity donation match up to $100
  • Fun team events outside of work hours - happy hours, “escape room” adventures, hikes, and more!

Sail through the process

Here at Shippo, we celebrate inclusivity and are committed to creating equal access to opportunities for people from all backgrounds, perspectives and geographies. These values define who we are and everything we do. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. If you need assistance, or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please contact us at

Shippos in the wild

Our people, much like the packages we help ship, are all over the world. This means, through our remote-first program, “Shippos Everywhere”, our roles can be based anywhere in the US with the exception of Delaware, Nevada, Ohio, Oregon, Hawaii, New Mexico and West Virginia and many roles can be based internationally.

For locations outside of the US and Ireland, the employment contracts are powered by Remote.com (all Shippo perks still apply - including equity!). What we want to emphasize is that you can be successful at Shippo regardless of location.

We leverage AI to review all resumes during the application phase to ensure fairness, comprehensively evaluate each submission, and mitigate bias. However, all decisions at every stage of the process are made by a real person.

description:
Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)

Remote-first (worldwide applicants welcome). Part-time freelance (5–20 h/week) with a clear path to full-time within 12 months based on impact. Compensation set based on agreed hours / scope of part-time role (flexible). Reports to Founder/Marketing/Head of Design.

About The Opportunity We are building a differentiated brand in a competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a “make it pretty” gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics. If you live and breathe design in tech/SaaS/AI, track the latest patterns, and want to grow from a part-time contributor into a core, full-time role, read on.

What You’ll Do

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end-to-end: insight → moodboard → concept → production → iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands-on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in-house).
  • You know the category patterns and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste with refined typography, layout discipline, and strategic restraint.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; strong references at your fingertips.
  • Bold when needed, able to defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast-paced, passionate, and easy to work with. Low-ego and crisp communicator.
  • Tools: Figma & WordPress / Elementor (power user); Adobe Illustrator as needed.
  • Bonus: light motion (After Effects, or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points

  • 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Ability to produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understanding performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat in 12 months through results. Ship work that’s seen by millions, not buried in decks. Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

What to Include

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, landing pages, campaign sets, brand work).
  • For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal, your role, and outcome (metrics if possible).
  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets).
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

How to Apply

  • Email: ******
  • Important: Share your LinkedIn and portfolio.

The more your application stands out, the faster we’ll respond. If you’re serious, add the optional Loom—personality matters. We move fast.

title: 3D Storyboarder/Layout Artist - Atrium
description:
Hello, talented creatives!

Atrium is Telos Media’s newest YouTube channel, from exploring inside Hitler's final hours to living in the horrifying conditions of Auschwitz. We take viewers to places that are now only accessible through animation and storytelling.

We’ve already had strong momentum, and now, we’re looking for a visionary Part-time 3D Camera Operator to help elevate our next videos.

This role is for someone who lives and breathes visual storytelling. You’ll work hand-in-hand with the Channel Director to map out the visual blueprint for each video—turning scripts into clear, engaging animatics that animators can then bring to life. Done right, your work sets the tone, style, and pacing of the visuals for each upload.

The goal is to take a 3D model we've created, like the inside of a submarine, and bring it to life using static characters and voice-over, all coming together into one final video. We\'re not looking to create test animatics or rough drafts. The aim is to go straight to producing the final version.

If you love storytelling and the process of visually bringing stories to life, then this is your chance to help build a premium content brand from the very beginning. Let’s make something incredible!

Responsibilities

  • Dig into scripts and understand the tone, message, and visual vibe
  • Create animatics that show camera movement, pacing, and animator notes
  • Collaborate with animators to make the vision come to life
  • Suggest visual solutions when something’s not clicking
  • Keep files and assets organized for smooth team access
  • Review final videos, gather feedback, and improve for next time

Must Haves

  • Several years of animation industry experience — YouTube, TV, or film
  • Knows Blender well enough to create the animatics inside it
  • Can adjust visual style depending on the script
  • Has a sharp eye for camera angles, timing, and transitions
  • Knows how to make microscopic or abstract concepts cinematic
  • Can create animatics that feel — emotionally powerful moments that land
  • Brings ideas to the table, not just drawings
  • Is constantly studying great visuals — from movies to sci-fi to docs
  • Is proactive, fast to respond, and excited to grow with us

Good to Haves

  • Can manage animation timelines and teams (as we scale)
  • Understand YouTube audience retention and how visuals play a part
  • Have a strong network of creatives in the space
  • Know how visuals can tap into emotion and psychology
  • Happy to jump in and help across the production process

Key Obsessions (What are you obsessed with?)

  • Obsessed with Visual Storytelling: Always thinking about how to tell a story visually — framing, pacing, movement, and how every shot contributes to the narrative.
  • Obsessed with Viewer Engagement: Constantly asking: “Will this keep the viewer watching?” They look at retention graphs, know how to build hooks, and design moments that emotionally land.
  • Obsessed with Efficiency: Loves building systems that speed things up. They design animatics that are clear, production-ready, and save the animators hours of guesswork.
  • Obsessed with Detail, Without Getting Slowed Down: They notice when a transition doesn’t feel right or a shot lacks emotional punch — but they also know how to move fast and not get stuck.
  • Obsessed with Growth & New Styles: Always exploring fresh visual techniques, studying references from all kinds of media, and pushing the style to evolve beyond the “usual.

We\'re a growing company looking for a Product Designer to join our team and help us design a user-centric SaaS dashboard to prevent fraud.

This isn\'t just about pixels; it\'s about problem-solving. You\'ll work closely with other designers, product managers, and engineers to understand complex challenges and create intuitive and comprehensive experiences for our users. We have a complex product; you will need to make it easy.

As a fast-growing start-up, you will need to independently explore the context, talk to different stakeholders, understand the problem end-to-end, and propose solutions that make sense with our product.

Requests usually come with just the tip of the iceberg. You will need to get into the bushes. This role is not for a Product Designer that expects a complete brief, a list of detailed tasks, and endless calls. We move fast. You need to be fast. And good.

What You\'ll Do

  • Proactively drive the entire design process, from independently identifying user problems and exploring solutions through research and validation, to final implementation and hand-off.

  • We are remote, you need to show visibility, communicate status, and progress reports with your team. Comment, annotate, and tag teammates in all your files. Work closely with product managers and engineers.

What You\'ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience (or strong portfolio) designing UI and UX for dashboards and SaaS products.

  • User-centered design principles with a strong understanding of data visualization best practices
  • Experience communicating with leadership. You will communicate ideas and ping pong requirements with the CEO, CTO, and CPO levels.
  • Be aware of the future state of design. AI is changing the game. We are already exploring new design workflows.
  • Startup / Small Company / Founder Experience

Bonus Points

  • Experience working in globally distributed teams
  • If you\'ve worked in Fraud, AML, Compliance, Payments, Fintech, Banking, that\'s a plus
  • Played around with Figma Make, Gemini, Loveable, v0, or similar? Sweet!
  • A little front-end code familiarity will make your job easier

Compensation

Base pay range of R$265,000- R$370,000 BRL + Series C equity with tremendous upside potential + Attractive benefits

The compensation offered for this role will depend on various factors, including the candidate\'s location, qualifications, work history, and interview performance, and may differ from the stated range.

Benefits We Offer

  • Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested
  • Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture
  • Flexible paid time off, Year-end break, Self care days off

title: Revenue Manager - Remote
description:
Compensation TypeYearly Highgate Hotels

Highgate is a premier real estate investment and hospitality management company widely recognized as an innovator in the industry. Highgate is the dominant player in U.S. gateway markets including New York, Boston, Miami, San Francisco and Honolulu, with a rapidly expanding presence in Europe, Latin America, and the Caribbean. Highgate’s portfolio of global properties represents an aggregate asset value exceeding $20B and generates over $5B in cumulative revenues. The company provides expert guidance through all stages of the hospitality property cycle, from planning and development through recapitalization or disposition. Highgate also has the creativity and bandwidth to develop bespoke hotel brands and utilizes industry-leading proprietary revenue management tools that identify and predict evolving market dynamics to drive out performance and maximize asset value. With an executive team consisting of some of the industry’s most experienced hotel management leaders, the company is a trusted partner for top ownership groups and major hotel brands. Highgate maintains corporate offices in London, New York, Dallas, and Seattle.

Location Overview

The Revenue Manager is responsible for identifying and maximizing all potential revenue opportunities for the hotel. In today’s lodging environment, understanding channel and yield management is critical for maximizing revenues.The Revenue Manager is responsible for formulating long and short-term Revenue Management strategies and for overseeing their successful execution towards the advancement of RevPAR market share.This includes the analysis of revenue potential generated by the transient and group market segments as well as the market segmentation within transient and group. One will combine this with catering and space utilization as well as other revenue considerations (i.e.: golf, spa, etc.) in order to determine the appropriate mix of business to achieve revenue potentials every day of every year.

Responsibilities
  • Establish hotel pricing levels in all segments.
  • Responsible for the daily room inventory management process and daily pricing process.
  • Monitor competitor rates, positioning, strategies and data; maintain understanding of the dynamics of the local market and demand generators and present appropriate action plans to management.
  • Monitor and communicate fluctuations in occupancy to operational departments so they can effectively manage staffing requirements and increase efficiency.
  • Analyze local events and activities and project the effect of opportunities they create.
  • Understand the macro and micro-economic variables affecting supply and demand in the local marketplace, and use this knowledge to create accurate operational and financial room revenue forecasts.
  • Perform unconstrained demand analysis to determine optimal business mix.
  • Responsible for all short and long term forecasts including Weekly Forecasts, Forecasts, In the month forecasts, and Full year forecasts.
  • Oversee process for evaluating all opportunities for contracted business (group, wholesale, corporate negotiated, etc.) presented through the Sales department. Ensure that process enables high speed of response while maximizing profits.
  • Responsible for the maintenance of any software programs which contribute to the management of rooms revenue, including the CRS, RMS, PMS and Sales & Catering system.
  • Monitor RevPAR index on STR report and provide critical analysis of performance on weekly and monthly basis.
  • Prepare annual Rooms revenue budget.
  • Chair weekly Revenue Strategy meetings in order to formulate and disseminate strategies and tactics. Ensure that prior decisions are re-visited in this forum in order to evaluate their effectiveness and promote learning.
  • Prepare and present quarterly presentations to ownership.
  • Ensure all distribution channels have correct content and pricing.
  • Develop and maintain a close relationship with the market manager of Third Party Intermediaries to maximize the opportunities with these channels.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with other market revenue managers and Directors of Revenue to create a network of peers in your community
  • Coordinate survey activities involving marketing and service opportunities to further enhance revenue potential.
  • Actively develop all subordinates, ensuring that they have opportunities to grow their Revenue Management and leadership skill base through personal attention, internal/external training and participation in industry events.
  • Responsible for Internet Marketing such as pay per click campaigns, e-mail blasts, GDS advertising, etc.
  • Establish and communicate sales strategy for day, week, month and rolling 12 months.
  • Communicate any strategy changes or update any calendars for the sales team to use.
  • Analyze prior night successes: Did the hotel sell out? Were the right decisions made for overselling? Address the opportunities in Highgate Hotel Business Review (HHBR) morning meeting.
  • Place test calls to Central Reservation Office (CRO) and property to ensure accuracy of rate quoting, restrictions and selling approach.
  • Manage and communicate group cut off dates. Run a group rooms control log (GRC) as well as pick up report from Property Management System (PMS) for 90 days. Verify pick up to actual block, cut off date, and whether or not you should extend, etc.
  • Update the Daily Market Segment Analysis (DMSA). Ensure accuracy from the daily Flash Report. Review actual performance versus Potential performance.
  • Complete all required month end reports with detailed analysis. If necessary, complete action plans for the property to follow to create additional production/revenue.
  • Review Hotelligence reports for trends, booking windows and sources of business as well as rates compared to competition.
Qualifications
  • At least 2 years experience in the Revenue Management field as manager or senior analyst
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Hotel or Hospitality Management or closely related field
  • In-Depth knowledge of all industry reports such as STR, Hotelligence, Market Vision, etc.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, Power Point
  • Ability to work quickly in a high-pressure & high stress environment
  • Ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing
  • Excellent time management skills
  • Exceptional with details and follow up
  • Flexible and long hours sometimes required.
  • Maintain a warm and friendly demeanor at all times.
  • Must be able to effectively communicate both verbally and written, with all level of employees and guests in an attentive, friendly, courteous and service oriented manner.
  • Must be effective at listening to, understanding, and clarifying concerns raised by employees and guests.
  • Must be able to multitask and prioritize departmental functions to meet deadlines.
  • Approach all encounters with guests and employees in an attentive, friendly, courteous and service-oriented manner.
  • Attend all hotel required meetings and trainings.
  • Participate in M.O.D. coverage as required.
  • Maintain regular attendance in compliance with Highgate Hotel Standards, as required by scheduling, which will vary according to the needs of the hotel.
  • Maintain high standards of personal appearance and grooming, which include wearing nametags.
  • Comply with Highgate Hotel Standards and regulations to encourage safe and efficient hotel operations.
  • Maximize efforts towards productivity, identify problem areas and assist in implementing solutions.
  • Must be effective in handling problems, including anticipating, preventing, identifying and solving problems as necessary.
  • Must be able to understand and evaluate complex information, data, etc. from various sources to meet appropriate objectives.
  • Must be able to maintain confidentiality of information.
  • Perform other duties as requested by management

Life at TRM Labs

Leadership Principles

Our Leadership Principles shape everything we do—how we make decisions, collaborate, and operate day to day.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer – We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson – We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague – We value humility, candor, and a one-team mindset.

Accelerate your Career

At TRM, you’ll do work that matters—disrupting terrorist networks, recovering stolen funds, and protecting people around the world. You will:

  • Work alongside top experts and learn every day.
  • Embrace a growth mindset with development opportunities tailored to your role.
  • Take on high-impact challenges in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Thrive in a culture of coaching, where feedback is fast, direct, and built to help you level up.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We know a lot of startups say that, but we mean it. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you’ll be joining a team that’s highly engaged, mission-driven, and constantly evolving.

To support this intensity, we’re also intentional about rest and recharge. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full time employees.

That said, TRM may not be the right fit for everyone. If you’re optimizing for work life balance, we encourage you to:

  • Ask your interviewers how they personally approach balance within their teams, and
  • Reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high-velocity environment.
  • Be honest with yourself about what energizes you—and what drains you

We’re upfront about this because we want every new team member to thrive—not just survive.

The Stakes Are Real

Our work has direct, real-world impact:

  • Jumping online after hours to support urgent government requests tracing ransomware payments.
  • Delivering actionable insights during terrorist financing investigations.
  • Collaborating across time zones in real time during a major global hack.
  • Building new processes in days, not weeks, to stop criminals before they cash out.
  • Analyzing blockchain data to recover stolen savings and dismantle trafficking networks.

Thrive as a Global Team

As a remote-first company, TRM Labs is built for global collaboration.

  • We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication, thorough documentation, and meaningful relationships.
  • We invest in offsites, regional meetups, virtual coffee chats, and onboarding buddies to foster collaboration.
  • By prioritizing trust and belonging, we harness the strengths of a global team while staying aligned with our mission and values.

Join our mission!

We’re looking for team members who thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and love building from the ground up. TRM is remote-first, with an exceptionally talented global team. If you enjoy solving tough problems and seeing your work make a difference for billions of people, we want you here. Don’t worry if your experience doesn’t perfectly match a job description—we value passion, problem-solving, and unique career paths. If you’re excited about TRM’s mission, we want to hear from you.

  • Explorar o uso de IA para acelerar a escrita de código, apoiar em testes e ampliar seu raciocínio durante o desenvolvimento.
  • Colocar sua entrega em produção, acompanhando como uma pipeline real chega aos usuários e entendendo seu impacto.

  • Github

Etapa 1: Inscrição

Você realiza sua inscrição preenchendo o formulário com seus dados, LinkedIn e currículo. Nosso time de tecnologia e recrutamento vai avaliar todas as candidaturas e selecionar quem avançará para a próxima fase.

Caso seu perfil seja selecionado, você participará de um desafio prático de programação, na linguagem de SQL e Python, em uma plataforma colaborativa indicada pelo avaliador. Durante a atividade, serão avaliados seu raciocínio lógico e capacidade de resolver problemas, a clareza na comunicação, bem como o domínio de estruturas de dados básicas

Overview

At TDS Telecom, connecting people is at the heart of everything we do. We are forward thinkers who leverage cutting-edge fiber internet technology to strengthen communities. We are dedicated to excellence, which drives us to succeed together, creating a better world through meaningful connections. Ready to make an impact?

As the Manager - Out of Territory (OOT) Route Acquisition , you will be responsible for managing TDS associates and consultants who plan, coordinate, and supervise Colocation and Joint Use activities across multiple locations and states. The role requires close collaboration with representatives from field services, associate managers, consultants, Outside Plant engineers, COLO/ROW team members, third-party consultants, and construction/engineering contractors supporting both TDS CLEC and ILEC operations to ensure company needs are effectively met.

In this role you will oversee Colocation and Joint Use activities for TDS Telecom fiber networks, ensuring compliance with existing RUS Outside Plant (OSP) guidelines and TDS OSP standards. This position supervises colocation team members managing OOT and CLEC/ILEC projects throughout the entire TDS footprint.

Key responsibilities include monitoring costs, maintaining and generating reports, enforcing adherence to TDS standards and practices, developing workflows and protocols as needed, and tracking overall job progress to ensure construction projects are completed on time and within budget. You will actively drive TDS initiatives at both the team and organizational levels.

Additionally, you will set goals and expectations while fostering a positive work environment that supports coaching and mentoring team members to achieve those goals. In this role you will also proactively identify opportunities to enhance the skills of each team member, contributing to the ongoing development and elevated performance of the entire team.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the management of TDS associates and/or consultants who are responsible for planning, coordinating and supervising Out of Territory Route Acquisition activities in multiple locations and states. The person filling this position is expected to work closely with representatives from field services, associate managers, Outside Plant Engineers, OSPC team members, 3rd party consultants and construction/engineering contractors for TDS Out of Territory (OOT) operations to ensure that the needs of the company are being met.
  • The incumbent will be responsible for the OOT Route Acquisition activities of TDS Telecom fiber networks while conforming to existing RUS Outside Plant (OSP) guidelines and TDS OSP. The incumbent will be responsible for continually working with various permitting entities, contractors, and agencies when/where applicable. Negotiation, coordination, and cooperation skills to expedite permitting/workflow crucial to this role.
  • Verify all permitting documentation to gain approved access for OSP construction activities (R/W, Easements, PUE, etc) is accurate, complete and clear. The incumbent will seek to drive consistency and clarity of all protocols to expedite permit approval process.
  • Verify that all documentation required to complete projects successfully, including Bid Jobs, build orders, Job Start Agreements, RFP, legal agreements, permitting agreements and close-out documentation is complete.
  • Review all required reports from OOT Route Acquisition team and contractor invoicing for accuracy. Role will track and process PO’s, Check Requests, CLARITY, etc to drive accuracy for reporting internally to TDS finance department.
  • The incumbent will use strong OSP & Route acquisition background to assist in troubleshooting escalated issues when necessary to achieve expedited results with permitting entities or internal teams.
  • Provides human resource management and manpower apportionment necessary for completion of network projects. This includes managing in-house deployment staff as well as engaging and managing professional consultant engineers during peak periods. Focus is on personnel development through performance assessments, coaching, recognition, and process improvement.
  • Conduct periodic quality assurance inspection of OSP projects performed by Local Operations personnel.
  • Manage specific projects OSP projects directly if schedule permits
  • Design projects and prepare OSP workplans for construction or modification of network facilities if schedule permits. Including confirm and analyze OTDR trace results to verify contractor splicing quality.
  • Assist in the training of field personnel on standards, RUS and TDS practices, time reporting codes and report/form preparation.
  • Provide recommendations to management for improving standards and practices resulting in higher quality and lower cost projects.
  • Assist Network Operations staff in developing Capital Additions, Budget assumptions and long-range planning.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree (or higher) -OR- 4+ years professional work experience.
  • 5+ years\' experience in telephony or related fields.
  • 3+ years\' supervisory experience
  • Must have and maintain a valid driver\'s license.

Other Qualifications:

  • Excellent leadership, project management, customer relations and communications skills
  • Thorough Understanding of Telecommunications industry and principals.
  • Deep understanding of CLARITY/PM style programs and creating analytic reports.
  • Thorough understanding of financial tracking and budgetary reporting.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Understanding of Colocation/Joint use process.
  • Excellent written and oral communications skills.
  • Outlook, Excel and Office suite as well as GIS and ESRi.
  • Working knowledge of RUS construction practices and engineering standards.
  • Ability to work in a cooperative and courteous manner with diverse work groups.
  • Must be self-motivated and self-reliant.
  • May be required to regular travel on an "as-needed" basis.

Do you meet the Required Qualifications but are unsure if your experience aligns with the Other Qualifications? We encourage you to apply! Research shows that many candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the qualifications, even when they possess the skills and experience needed to succeed in the role. Experience and skills come in many forms, and they may not always match exactly what’s listed on paper, but they can still lead to success. If you meet the Required Qualifications and believe you have the potential to thrive in this role, we encourage you to apply today!

Who is TDS Telecom?

TDS Telecom provides high-speed internet, TV entertainment, and phone services to a diverse range of communities, including small to mid-sized urban, suburban, and rural areas across the U.S. With over 50 years of experience, TDS is committed to building and expanding fiber optic networks that bring cutting-edge connectivity to neighborhoods nationwide. We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).   • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).

Join to apply for the Email Marketing Associate role at Darkroom .

About Darkroom Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

About The Role We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you\'ll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience. Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance, while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients.
  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.
  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages.
  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client\'s retention marketing calendars.
  • You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.
  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.
  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.
  • Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are

We\'re looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.
  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry.
  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.
  • You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc.
  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.
  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

Benefits

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

description:

Você conhece a Icon?
Apaixonados por pessoas e especialistas em tecnologia. Nosso trabalho é encontrar talentos e soluções sob medida para os nossos clientes. Vem encontrar o seu projeto ideal conosco e participar da comunidade ICON!

Overview

Área: Qualidade de Software. A área é peça-chave na entrega de produtos robustos, confiáveis e com altíssima performance. A missão é apoiar todas as tribos e squads no desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis, promovendo uma experiência fluida e segura para usuários finais ou stakeholders internos.

Código da vaga: A

Modelo de contratação: PJ

Responsibilities

  • Promover excelência nas entregas de software por meio da definição, padronização e evolução contínua de processos e ferramentas de QA;
  • Atuar como liderança técnica em estratégias de testes, automação, observabilidade de qualidade, testes de performance e validação de sistemas críticos;
  • Desenvolver serviços e ferramentas dedicados ao processo de Qualidade de Software;
  • Conduzir PoCs com agentes de IA e ferramentas emergentes, explorando sua aplicação em tarefas de QA e validação inteligente;
  • Liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua, projetos de engenharia da qualidade e integração com pipelines CI/CD;
  • Fomentar uma cultura sólida de qualidade por meio de treinamentos, mentorias técnicas e evangelização de boas práticas junto aos times de engenharia.

Atividades que você vai protagonizar

  • Conduzir discoveries técnicos, benchmarks e provas de conceito (PoCs) voltadas à evolução das práticas, ferramentas e soluções inteligentes para QA;
  • Traduzir iniciativas e ferramentas para desdobramento aos demais QAs;
  • Apoio direto no desdobramento e acompanhamento de indicadores do time de QA;
  • Mentorar e apoiar a evolução técnica de profissionais de QA, disseminando boas práticas de engenharia de testes e automação;
  • Propor, desenvolver e manter serviços auxiliares para compor o fluxo de QA;
  • Explorar, testar e integrar agentes de IA para identificação de padrões, geração de casos de teste, automação, análise de falhas ou priorização de testes;
  • Apoiar times de engenharia na definição de estratégias de testes, cobertura, qualidade de código e gates em pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Construir e manter pipelines de testes integradas ao processo de entrega contínua (CI/CD);
  • Criar, executar e manter testes automatizados, manuais e de performance, garantindo a confiabilidade e escalabilidade das soluções;
  • Analisar funcionalidades e riscos técnicos para elaboração de planos de testes eficazes, cobrindo múltiplos níveis de validação;
  • Atuar com times de engenharia em processos de troubleshooting e debugging, com foco na rastreabilidade e mitigação de falhas.

Requisitos e habilidades técnicas

  • Domínio em automação de testes (UI, API, mobile, integração, etc.), com experiência prática em Cypress, Appium, Selenium e Postman;
  • Experiência em integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD), utilizando ferramentas como GitHub Actions, GitLab CI ou similares;
  • Conhecimento avançado em engenharia e arquitetura de software, com foco em escalabilidade, testabilidade e manutenibilidade de sistemas;
  • Programação de sistemas com habilidade para construir serviços auxiliares e ferramentas dedicadas a testes;
  • Conhecimento em análise de qualidade de código utilizando SonarQube, SonarCloud ou outras ferramentas similares;
  • Experiência prática com a criação e uso de agentes de Inteligência Artificial aplicados a testes, como geração de casos, análise preditiva ou testes autônomos;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em bancos de dados relacionais (ex PostgreSQL, MySQL) e não relacionais (ex MongoDB, DynamoDB);
  • Capacidade de executar e interpretar testes de performance (stress, carga, pico), com domínio de ferramentas como JMeter, K6 e soluções em nuvem (IaaS);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade, como NewRelic, Grafana, CloudWatch (AWS);
  • Familiaridade com Jira e Confluence para gestão de tarefas, bugs, documentações e estratégias de testes;
  • Experiência sólida em metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban, com atuação ativa em cerimônias e entregas iterativas;
  • Prática com controle de versão e repositórios Git, seguindo boas práticas de branching e code review.

Perfil comportamental

  • Comunicação clara e eficaz com múltiplos públicos (Dev, Produto, Plataforma, Diretoria);
  • Alta capacidade analítica e de antecipação de riscos;
  • Proatividade, autonomia e senso de dono;
  • Resiliência para lidar com mudanças e resolver problemas com agilidade;
  • Capacidade de mentorar e desenvolver colegas de equipe.

Formação

  • Superior completo em áreas de tecnologia/gestão tecnologia ou correlatas.

Diferenciais

Overview

APTIM's Energy Transition is seeking an experienced Sr. Account Manager . This position is based in Minnesota and serves as a primary conduit to the market providing education and collaboration to stakeholders on behalf of the HOMES/HEAR program. APTIM's role is to develop and manage Home Energy Rebates created through the Inflation Reduction Act including the Home Efficiency Rebate Program (HOMES) and the Home Electrification and Appliance Rebate Program (HEAR). The Sr. Account Manager will be responsible for networking with customers and stakeholders to drive program performance and goal attainment. Residential program knowledge and technical expertise in energy efficiency and electrification is required. This role will report to the Program Manager.

APTIM's Energy Transition team is a recognized leader in the marketplace. Our technical experts deliver highly innovative projects and complex client solutions providing the full breadth of energy solutions including energy management, carbon management, smart energy infrastructure, distributed energy resources (DER), and carbon-free mobility solutions. Our consultants proactively collaborate with clients to define and implement strategies and campaigns around key business drivers, with the primary focus of finding and delivering high-impact projects exceeding expectations and meeting the unique needs for our clients.

The successful candidate will immediately assume an active role supporting the planning and operational activities for the programs. The Sr. Account Manager is responsible for utilizing existing community partners and building a network of stakeholders and customers targeting energy efficiency projects that align with the HOMES/HEAR program. The Sr. Account Manager will be expected to engage with organizations proactively to understand their unique goals and challenges and communicate how the HOMES/HEAR programs can support those goals and challenges. This position will be a critical member of the team by informing overarching strategic direction and driving new initiatives and energy savings.

This position is based in Minnesota and will have frequent day travel within specific territories. There is the opportunity for travel outside of the area, sporadically, for conferences, events, and continuing education. The Sr. Account Manager must be a critical thinker, able to manage multiple tasks, have excellent written and verbal communication skills, and be able to maintain positive relationships with colleagues, stakeholders, and partners. The role requires a person who is accountable, process driven, detail-oriented, and pragmatic. Individuals in this role will be expected to embrace a collaborative approach, take ownership of their workspace, and find solutions to challenges as they arise and be highly flexible to adjust to program needs. In this role, you will be working with others who are passionate about clean energy, energy efficiency, and making a positive impact on the industry.

Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities

  • Work as part of an energy efficiency and electrification team ensuring the administration, implementation, and verification of federally funded energy efficiency projects are successfully executed.
  • Develop reporting that aligns with DOE requirements and provides operations leadership insights to improve operations.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage existing or potential organizations to produce qualified leads, layer services/rebates and/or improve the customer experience, driving project participation.
  • Connect regularly with organizations via phone, email, virtual platforms, and face-to-face discussions to ensure they are current on HOMES/HEAR offerings and efforts, and to gain the organizations perspective on issues relating to the programs.
  • Lead and project manage initiatives that drive toward improved customer experience and participation in programs.
  • Develop and lead presentations promoting HOMES/HEAR programs at various conferences, community events, or professional organizations.
  • Respond to direct inquiries and requests made by customers, organizations, and stakeholders in a timely manner.
  • Deliver supporting information, collateral, and contacts to partners to support deepened customer engagement.
  • Be attuned to broad regulator, policy, and economic concerns impacting programs and bring these perspectives to program leadership.
  • Perform field QAQC as needed within assigned territory.
  • Frequent day travel and occasional overnight (depending on conferences, training or other opportunities).
  • All other duties as assigned.
  • Ensuring compliance with all APTIM quality and safety policies as well as all OSHA regulations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year college or university or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of industry experience required.
  • Knowledge of energy efficiency and electrification programs.
  • Experience working with any of the following stakeholders: businesses, contractors, utilities, CBOs, community leaders, retailers, program implementers, manufacturers or distributors of energy-efficient equipment or services.
  • Strong service orientation with the ability to work across multiple departments and units within an organization, external clients, and multiple stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent time management, project management, and follow-through; creative problem solver with strong analytical abilities.
  • Ability to absorb information from multiple parties and formulate necessary communications or decisions quickly.
  • Conceptual understanding of energy efficiency, electrification, renewable energy, and the types of equipment, technologies, and building practices relevant to residential customers.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Experience in the use of typical productivity software tools.
  • Strong quantitative and analytic capabilities to interpret data and solve practical problems.
  • Exceptional relationship management skills.
  • Ability to travel within Minnesota regularly and occasionally out-of-state.
  • Must be a self-starter, organized and have an ability to manage competing priorities with established deadlines.
  • Commitment to fostering a collaborative work environment within the team and broader organization.

At Innodata, we\'re working with the world\'s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We\'re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Chemistry Subject Matter Expert (SME) to contribute to the development and training of AI Large Language Models (LLMs).

  • Collaborate with AI researchers, data scientists, and engineers to train, refine, and evaluate Large Language Models with a focus on Chemistry content.

  • Assist in creating and annotating training datasets, including classification, tagging, and contextual labeling of chemistry-related data.
  • Ensure all content meets scientific rigor and is aligned with industry best practices.
  • Stay up to date with the latest advancements in Chemistry and AI to continuously improve training methodologies.

Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related scientific field.
  • Strong theoretical and practical knowledge of chemistry concepts (Organic, Inorganic, Physical, Analytical, Biochemistry, etc.).
  • Prior experience in academic research, technical writing, or teaching is highly desirable.
  • Experience working with data annotation, content development, or training AI models is a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
